extra.reason: Removed unreachable JSON-string fallback in renderSlide — verified zero string-typed content fields across all four sections of data.json. Removed unused keyTakeaways. Microlearning table rendering now shares renderTable() with the study book. Callout markup intentionally diverges (book uses SVG icons, microlearning uses emoji cards) so it stays separate.

Removed unused secNum arg from printFlashcards (CSS handles print scoping via .flash-print-grid). Added null-state guards to all quiz/flash handlers so stray events after navigation no-op cleanly. route() now nulls __quizState/__flashState on each transition.

Added delegated keydown handler (Enter/Space → click) for any [role=button]. Tagged all 5 clickable divs (section-card x2, ml-lesson-card, flashcard-wrapper, exam choice) with role=button + tabindex + aria-label. Disabled exam choices get tabindex=-1 and aria-disabled. Added :focus-visible outline so keyboard users see their position.
Modal now has role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby. Open moves focus to first interactive control and records the trigger; close returns focus to it. Esc closes; Tab is trapped within the modal.

Removed both jsPDF script tags from index.html. New loadJsPdf() injects them on first click of Download Study Guide, caches the promise so subsequent clicks reuse the loaded library. Failure shows an alert and bails.

Won't fix at current scale. data.json is 787KB uncompressed (~140KB gzipped via Caddy 'encode zstd gzip'). Splitting adds async section-load machinery + cache management across many call sites for a minor wire-size win. Revisit when total exceeds ~2MB uncompressed or when initial paint becomes user-visible-slow. Per-section sizes recorded for reference: s1_book 104KB, s2_book 117KB; smallest is s4_flash 17KB.

renderResourceLanding now escapes c.title, c.subtitle, c.description, and s.title via escHtml. c.icon stays as raw SVG (intentional — comment added). The other section-card render path (renderHome) already escaped its strings; no change needed there.

Header logo: 2141x3000 source → 27x38 attrs (matches CSS height:38px / width:auto). Footer logo: 7027x1800 source → 148x38 attrs (matches CSS height:38px). Aspect ratios preserved; layout no longer shifts as PNGs load.

Containerized. Dockerfile (node:22-alpine, multi-stage, non-root UID 1000), docker-compose.yml (API + lareprep-postgres on internal network, joins external portainer-proxy_proxy for Caddy). API container serves static + /api/* — single image, no bind-mounts needed for frontend. Postgres uses container_name lareprep-postgres (not service name) to dodge the n8n-postgres DNS collision. Volume mounted at /var/lib/postgresql for PG18+ layout. End-to-end verified: schema auto-applied via /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d, PUT/GET round-trips through jsonb, healthcheck green, static serves with correct MIME types, path traversal blocked. Stale systemd unit removed.

Vanilla-Node adaptation of the skill's Next.js pattern landed. server/auth/{jwt,session,impexium,routes}.js, login.html, gating in server/index.js. Cookie asla_lareprep_session, 8h max + 2h sliding inactivity, HttpOnly + Secure-when-x-forwarded-proto=https + SameSite=Lax. validateSsoCallback enforces id match + isApproved + at least one active membership (membership-type + paid-product gates deferred). /api/progress now reads customerId from validated JWT, no header trust. dev-login endpoint usable in development, returns 403 in production. Schema migrated from device_id uuid to user_id text. End-to-end verified in compose: unauthed → 302 to /login, dev-login → cookie set, me/static/PUT/GET progress all round-trip on the cookie.

All 6 findings addressed. C1: login.html client-side rejects any redirect not matching /^\/(?!\/)/ — closes phishing-grade visual confusion. H1: jwt.js now carries sessionStart through refreshToken; isAbsoluteTimeout enforces the 8h cap in getSession (canonical impl has the same bug — divergence documented in code). H2: dev-login route is only registered when NODE_ENV != production AND DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true; verified that NODE_ENV=production + DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true still blocks. M2: .otf in MIME map. M3: appBaseUrl() requires APP_URL env var, no X-Forwarded-Host trust for origin validation. M4: impexiumSsoToken removed from transformToSessionUser — confirmed absent in JWT payload via base64 decode. End-to-end smoke still passes.
